maddeler.e:
اختطيا (form VIII)
# اِخْتَطَيَا (iḵtaṭayā) /ix.ta.tˤa.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِخْتَطَى (iḵtaṭā)
# اُخْتُطِيَا (uḵtuṭiyā) /ux.tu.tˤi.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِخْتَطَى (iḵtaṭā)
# اِخْتَطِيَا (iḵtaṭiyā) /ix.ta.tˤi.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِخْتَطَى (iḵtaṭā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
